Both changes are in. Please try the new behavior:

**→ http://maker:4001**

**1. Duplicates are now prevented (not warned).**
In "Save a link", type `https://github.com/tldr-pages/tldr` (a link you already have), click **Get details**, then **Save bookmark**. Instead of a second copy, the app jumps to the existing bookmark, briefly highlights it, and **opens it in edit mode**, with a message saying it already exists.

**2. Edit it.**
In that opened editor, change the **Title** or add a **tag**, then click **Save changes** — you'll see "Changes saved" and the card shows your update. (There's also a **Cancel** to discard.)

**3. A duplicate that lives in the Archive.**
Now type `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmark_(digital)` (the pre-archived example), click **Get details**, then **Save bookmark**. The app switches you to the **Archived** tab, tells you it's there, and opens it for editing.

**4. Editing any bookmark directly.**
On any card, notice the new **Edit** button — that's how you correct a bookmark's details any time, not just on duplicates.

Two choices I made — please confirm:

- **You can edit the Title, Description, Tags, and Note, but not the web address itself** — my reasoning is that a different address is really a different bookmark. Is that right, or do you want to edit the address too?
- I added the **Edit** button to cards **in every tab, including Archived** (previously archived cards showed only "Restore"). That's so you can edit the existing one wherever the duplicate check finds it. Good?

Try these and let me know.
